question: What is India's rank in the Global Gender Gap Report 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**131**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India slips to 131st position in Global Gender Gap Index 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India** ranked **131 out of 148 countries** in the **Global Gender Gap Report 2025**, dropping **2 positions** from **129** last year.

 
 
• 
 
India’s **parity score** is **64.1%**, making it one of the **lowest-ranked countries in South Asia**.

 
 
• 
 
The index measures gender parity across four dimensions:

 
 
• 
 
**Economic Participation and Opportunity**

 
 
• 
 
**Educational Attainment**

 
 
• 
 
**Health and Survival**

 
 
• 
 
**Political Empowerment**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Bangladesh** ranked **24**, becoming the **best performer in South Asia**, jumping **75 ranks**.

 
 
• 
 
Other South Asian ranks:

 
 
• 
 
**Nepal** – 125

 
 
• 
 
**Sri Lanka** – 130

 
 
• 
 
**Bhutan** – 119

 
 
• 
 
**Maldives** – 138

 
 
• 
 
**Pakistan** – 148 (last)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The **global gender gap** has closed to **68.8%**, showing the **strongest progress since the pandemic**.

 
 
• 
 
**Iceland** is the **top-ranked country for the 16th consecutive year**, followed by **Finland**, **Norway**, **UK**, and **New Zealand**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **19th edition** of the report, covering **148 economies**.
